# itch.io

> > itch.io is an open indie game marketplace and distribution platform enabling developers to host, sell, and monetize games while players discover and play independent titles across multiple platforms.

itch.io serves as a central hub for indie game developers and players, offering game hosting, digital distribution, asset marketplaces, and community features. The platform supports multiple platforms including Windows, macOS, Linux, Web, iOS, and Android, with extensive filtering by genre, input methods (controller support for Xbox, PlayStation, Joy-Con, Kinect, etc.), and game characteristics.

## Game Discovery & Browsing

- [Download the latest indie games - itch.io](https://itch.io): itch.io homepage: indie game marketplace for discovering and distributing games
- [Top games - itch.io](https://itch.io/games): Main game discovery and browsing hub with filtering across platforms
- [Top free games - itch.io](https://itch.io/games/free): Free games discovery page with platform and genre filtering options
- [Top paid games - itch.io](https://itch.io/games/store): Paid games marketplace with filtering by platform and input methods
- [Top games for Web - itch.io](https://itch.io/games/platform-web): Web-based games discovery and browsing on itch.io
- [Top games tagged Horror - itch.io](https://itch.io/games/tag-horror): Horror games browsing with tag filtering and genre discovery
- [Top games tagged Multiplayer - itch.io](https://itch.io/games/tag-multiplayer): Multiplayer games discovery with local and online filtering
- [Fun games - Top games - itch.io](https://itch.io/games/fun): Curated fun games collection for indie game discovery
- [Top tags - itch.io](https://itch.io/tags): Directory of content tags and categories for game discovery

## Developer Platform & Distribution

- [Sell your indie games online - itch.io](https://itch.io/developers): Developer platform for hosting, selling, and distributing indie games
- [Devlogs - itch.io](https://itch.io/devlogs): Community developer logs showcasing game development updates and releases
- [Game jams - itch.io](https://itch.io/jams): Game jam directory and calendar for community game development events
- [Game development jobs - itch.io](https://itch.io/jobs): Game industry job listings and hiring opportunities
- [itch.io Community - itch.io](https://itch.io/community): Community forum and discussion boards for developers and players

## Game Development Resources

- [Top tools - itch.io](https://itch.io/tools): Game development tools marketplace including editors and utilities
- [Top game assets - itch.io](https://itch.io/game-assets): Game assets marketplace for sprites, music, and 3D models
- [Top Game Engines - itch.io](https://itch.io/game-development/engines): Game engine directory including Unity, Godot, and GameMaker
